turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    subgraph ASSAY["ASSAY — read-only"]
        C[Read received document]
        D[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
        E[Compress to floor content]
        F[Name evaporated content and its function]
        G[Locate operative sentence]
        H[Report ratio, erosion direction, and missing rough edge]
        I["Output Residue / Evaporated / Operative sentence / Finding"]
        J["This is a finding, not a draft."]
        C --> D --> E --> F --> G --> H --> I --> J
    end

    subgraph PROVIDE["PROVIDE — negotiation side"]
        K{Mode stated or inferable?}
        L[Ask for mode]
        M{Floor passes?}
        N[Ask for missing floor items]
        O[State assumptions for remaining gaps]
        P[Wait for answer]
        Q[Compress the prompt]
        R{Cut removed specification?}
        S[Name decorative or destructive cut]
        T[Revert to last passing version]
        U{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
        V[Say the contract is minimal]
        W[Output optimized prompt]
        K -- no --> L --> P --> K
        K -- yes --> M
        M -- no --> N --> O --> P --> M
        M -- yes --> Q --> R
        R -- yes --> S --> T --> Q
        R -- no --> U
        U -- no --> M
        U -- yes --> V --> W
    end

    B -- received document --> C
    B -- draft prompt --> K
    W --> X["Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?"]
    X -- keep negotiating --> Q
    X -- freeze / execute / run it --> Y{Human signer named?}
    Y -- no --> Z[Gate stays closed]
    Y -- yes --> AA{Execution tools available?}
    AA -- no --> Z
    AA -- yes --> AB["Contract frozen. Executing."]
    AB --> AC{Result}
    AC -- success --> AD[Done]
    AC -- floor failure --> AE["Failed on [item]. Contract reopened."]
    AE --> Q
```
